**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity, § 3.4).**

- **What works:** Customer has a convenience right on one month's notice, and IBM has *no* convenience termination right at all (§ 3.3 is for-cause only) — both at or better than the preferred position.
- **What fails:** the right is gated on uncapped "early termination charges" imported from Attachment A / Service Option Attachments, and there is no refund of prepaid Charges (§ 3.5 only accelerates accrued amounts). An uncapped exit charge falls short of the fallback's three-months'-fees cap.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** cap the early termination charges at three (3) months' Charges for the terminated Services, and add a 30-day pro-rata refund of prepaid Charges.
